# Requirements Quality Checklist: Plant Location Dashboard

**Purpose**: Assess whether the feature specification is complete, clear, consistent, and ready for implementation
**Created**: 2026-11-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on the
feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact.
Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is
satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements
quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the two authoritative source feeds identified, including the role of each feed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the visitor’s primary goal and the value of combining watering and specimen information clearly stated? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all visitor-facing plant, specimen, and location attributes that matter to the feature identified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005–FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the single-page scope explicitly distinguished from excluded detail pages, editing, accounts, and persistence? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK005 Are loading, successful results, no results, and source failure states all specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009–FR-011]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the relationship between `thirstyplants.id` and `specimens.plant_id` stated without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK007 Is “frequently watered” consistently used to describe the qualifying plant set? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK008 Are optional source fields and their empty-value treatment explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the required GPS representation limited to latitude and longitude, without implying an interactive map? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the result ordering rule specific enough to produce the same order for the same source data? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the meaning of “first page” unambiguously tied to the initial page presented to a visitor? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do the requirement to show every matching specimen and the exclusion of pagination, search, and filtering controls agree? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK013 Do the complete-data failure rule and the prohibition on incomplete combined results agree across user scenarios, requirements, and edge cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK014 Do the display requirements consistently distinguish plant identifiers from specimen identifiers? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK015 Do the assumptions about no interactive map and coordinate-only location presentation agree with the location requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Can each functional requirement be objectively evaluated from the written requirement and its acceptance scenarios? [Measurability, Spec §Functional Requirements]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the 3-second and 95-percent performance targets defined with a clear measurement context? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the result-integrity and failure-state success criteria measurable without prescribing an implementation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, SC-004]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the first-attempt visitor outcome have a defined interpretation for the 90-percent target? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK020 Are supported desktop and mobile viewport expectations sufficiently bounded for acceptance? [Completeness, Spec §SC-006, FR-013]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are primary successful-result scenarios complete for matching specimens and multiple specimens sharing one plant? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1–2, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are unmatched specimens and plants without specimens explicitly addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-003]
- [ ] CHK023 Are empty, malformed, duplicate, unavailable, and slow source-data conditions covered without contradictory outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the distinction between an empty successful feed and an unavailable or invalid feed explicit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010–FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Are missing optional address and notes values addressed without weakening the required coordinate information? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 Are keyboard accessibility and responsive presentation requirements defined for the complete visitor experience? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK027 Are performance expectations stated as measurable user outcomes rather than implementation-specific metrics? [Clarity, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK028 Are security, privacy, and credential-handling expectations stated for the public read-only experience and its external dependencies? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Are availability, retry, timeout, and recovery expectations for external feed failures sufficiently specified for release acceptance? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-010]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK030 Are the public feed dependencies, their required fields, and their failure conditions documented consistently? [Dependency, Spec §FR-001–FR-002, Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the assumption that identifier values share a common numeric domain stated and constrained? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK032 Are the source-data authority, freshness expectations, and absence of historical snapshots clearly bounded? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK033 Are all out-of-scope capabilities that could expand the one-page experience explicitly listed? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## Traceability and Readiness

- [ ] CHK034 Can every user story be traced to functional requirements and measurable success criteria? [Traceability, Spec §User Stories, Requirements, Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK035 Can every clarification decision be traced to a current requirement or assumption without obsolete alternatives remaining? [Traceability, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK036 Are the specification, data model, external feed contract, and implementation plan aligned on terminology and relationships? [Consistency, Plan §Project Structure, Data Model, Contracts]
- [ ] CHK037 Does the specification contain enough domain detail for planning without prescribing implementation choices? [Readiness, Spec §Requirements, Plan §Technical Context]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after a reviewer confirms the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation is still required.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add findings or links inline when a checklist item identifies a specification gap.
